description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the EvaluateVideoQuality operation in the video understanding (videorecog) category
description_zh: 本文介绍视频理解（videorecog）类目下的视频画质评估EvaluateVideoQuality的语法及示例
name: EvaluateVideoQuality

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en:
The quality assessment mode. Valid values:
- general (default): basic quality assessment.
- vqa_plus: basic quality assessment and defect quality assessment
parameters.help_zh:
质量评估模式。取值如下：
- general（默认）：基础质量评估。
- vqa_plus：基础质量评估及瑕疵质量评估
parameters.name: mode
